prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 32 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1216; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Treatment summary. The patient presented after a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back strain. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type, and a lumbar strain is a plausible diagnosis. Over the course of care the patient attended 32 visits, many times the number usually seen for an uncomplicated strain, with appointments occurring nearly every day. Additional body regions were reported several weeks after the collision and added to the plan. Imaging and standard clinical examinations have been within normal limits. Nearly all documented findings rest on the patient's own pain reports rather than objective measures. No prior injury to the lumbar area is known from available records. Two similar billing entries recorded on the same date of service are currently under review to confirm they are accurate.
